# Background textures

These seamless textures are colour maps from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com),
released under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). They were resized, and the
cardstock colours tinted from Paper001, by scripts/vendor-background-textures.py.
